title: RedTeamSynthesis
description: Harness-authored synthesis.json for S12 red-team-review. Written into the shared --state-dir after ingesting security.json + threat.json. The Python pipeline validates each object against strict (extra="forbid", frozen) Pydantic models on `forge-validate red-team-review --state-dir <dir>`; any unknown key or missing field is a hard ValidationError (exit 1). Keys must match these names EXACTLY.

chains.description: Exploit chains — sequences of S11/S10 findings that combine into an end-to-end attack.

trees.description: Attack trees — one pre-rendered Mermaid diagram per exploit objective.

abuse_cases.description: Per-role abuse cases (enhanced when an S61 /functional-map is available).

impact.description: Closed enum — NOT free text, and there is NO "severity" field on a chain.

finding_id.description: A ThreatNode id from the ingested graph (must exist in security.json/threat.json, else the step is dropped with a warning).

file.description: Cite a real file from the finding.

line.description: Cite a real line from the finding.

effect.description: What this step achieves — the key is "effect", NOT "action".

mermaid.description: A PRE-RENDERED Mermaid `graph TD` string (the pipeline does not render it for you).

finding_ids.description: PLURAL — an array of ThreatNode ids.

rank.description: 1 = fix first — the key is "rank", NOT "priority".

addresses.description: Chain / finding ids this fix addresses.
